QuestInfo.name: Arec's Test
QuestInfo.1: Arec says that he will officially recognize the Dual Blades if you can pass his test. Hunt the #bWhite Fangs#k, the legendary white hunters, and bring back their drops.
QuestInfo.2: Arec said that he would officially recognize the Dual Blades if you passed his test, which was to hunt the #bWhite Fangs#k, the legendary white hunters, and bring back their drops. You passed Arec's test by hunting #b100#k White Fangs and bringing back #b50 White Fang Tails#k.

0.0: If you pass my test, I will officially recognize you and the Dual Blades. Receiving my recognition will help you launch the new future as you so desire. Will you accept my test?

yes.0: The #bWhite Fangs#k that live in the snow fields of El Nath are known as the white hunters, because they are dangerously violent. Many residents of El Nath have fallen victim to them. Go hunt #b100 White Fangs#k and bring back #b50 White Fang Tails#k. This will be your test.

no.0: If you refuse my test, I will not officially recognize you. You will regret denying this rare opportunity.

1.0: Well, you have done it. Syl is lucky to have people like you. I have no choice but to recognize you and the Dual Blades on behalf of your effort and determination. Just don't let this get to your pride...

item.0: The #bWhite Fangs#k that live in the snow fields of El Nath are known as the white hunters, because they are dangerously violent. Many residents of El Nath have fallen victim to them. Go hunt 100 White Fangs and bring back #b50 White Fang Tails#k. This will be your test.
